title: Storage, working set and residency are independent facts
description: Remote provider availability, retained source and artifact bytes, logical working-set membership, current READY deployment and loaded engine resources are separate facts. Explicit commands cross boundaries. Managed copies and external references do not change provenance; cache does not prove identity. UMA device-addressability does not establish physical page residency.

panels.title: a  Durable source and representation facts
b  Deployment and live runtime facts
c  Orthogonal location classes — not promotion stages

nodes.title: Remote record
lines: provider + revision
availability / identity
no local bytes implied

nodes.title: Retained source
lines: immutable bytes
product acquisition
not a deployment

nodes.title: Representation / artifact
lines: source-derived bytes + authenticated derivation
local file presence alone is insufficient

nodes.title: Logical model library
lines: joins source, artifact and deployment facts
working-set membership is a logical ID set
membership creates neither bytes nor engines
remote-only records can retain provenance

nodes.title: READY deployment
lines: artifact + binding + current compatibility
a catalog fact, not memory residency
admission may still refuse resource pressure

nodes.title: Loaded engine generation
lines: mappings / prepared resources / backend placement
model active includes idle loaded engines

nodes.title: Active execution work
lines: explicit request on an admitted generation
session state and transient work are distinct
leases pin engines; release is not unload
no automatic intent routing or eviction

labels.text: Managed copy       |       External reference       |       Cache / temporary state
